desc: The Antalya showcases Grade 4 walnut stocks and utilizes Inertia Piston with Inertia Plus Rotating Bolt action. Both models come with interchangeable MaraPro chokes and options for 28" or 30" barrels. The Elegant variant is distinguished by its aesthetic appeal and precision aiming facilitated by a TruGlo Fiber optic sight, while the Jet Black model captivates with its polished black receiver—designed for hunters and shooting enthusiasts who prioritize functionality alongside style.
